initial_candidates.exit_logic: Time stop to capture the reversal impulse.
initial_candidates.falsification: Fails if momentum failures do not produce a profitable reversal within 12 bars.
initial_candidates.invalidation: Momentum re-accelerates in the original direction.
initial_candidates.mechanism: Momentum divergence indicates exhausted buying/selling pressure, leading to a reversal.
initial_candidates.payer: Traders trapped on the wrong side of fading momentum.
initial_candidates.time_stop_rationale: Momentum failures should result in immediate price rejection.
initial_candidates.turnover_cost_budget: Reversal moves from momentum failures exceed 30bps.
initial_candidates.why_distinct: Replaces pullback continuation with momentum failure reversal.

initial_candidates.exit_logic: Time stop to capture the confirmed trend continuation.
initial_candidates.falsification: Fails if multi-factor alignment does not improve win rate over single-factor trend following.
initial_candidates.invalidation: One or more factors diverge shortly after entry.
initial_candidates.mechanism: Combining trend, momentum, and volume factors filters out false signals and confirms true directional moves.
initial_candidates.payer: Uninformed traders acting on single-factor noise.
initial_candidates.time_stop_rationale: Multi-factor alignment should yield immediate and sustained price movement.
initial_candidates.turnover_cost_budget: Confirmed trends yield significant moves, easily covering costs.
initial_candidates.why_distinct: Enhances basic trend following with strict multi-factor volume and momentum confirmation.

initial_candidates.exit_logic: Time stop to capture the immediate exhaustion reversion.
initial_candidates.falsification: Fails if volatility spikes lead to continuation rather than reversion in the out-of-sample period.
initial_candidates.invalidation: Price continues to trend strongly after the spike.
initial_candidates.mechanism: Aggressive market orders exhaust local liquidity, causing a temporary price reversion.
initial_candidates.time_stop_rationale: Exhaustion reversions are short-lived before the broader trend resumes.
initial_candidates.turnover_cost_budget: Reversion from a volatility spike typically yields 40bps, covering costs.
initial_candidates.why_distinct: Shifts from trend-following Keltner channels to fading volatility extremes.

initial_candidates.entry_event: Price closes beyond the 20-period highest high or lowest low.

initial_candidates.exit_logic: Time stop to capture the initial breakout impulse.
initial_candidates.falsification: Fails if breakout trades revert within the first 3 bars more than 60% of the time.
initial_candidates.invalidation: Price immediately reverts back into the channel.
initial_candidates.mechanism: Trend followers pay for liquidity when price breaks out of a defined channel, expecting persistence.
initial_candidates.payer: Mean-reversion traders who are stopped out.
initial_candidates.time_stop_rationale: Breakout persistence should materialize within a few bars; otherwise, it is a false break.
initial_candidates.turnover_cost_budget: Breakout moves typically exceed 30bps, covering the 14bps cost.
initial_candidates.why_distinct: Replaces the previous continuation logic with a strict channel breakout.

initial_candidates.entry_event: Price closes outside the recent high/low range.

initial_candidates.exit_logic: Time stop to capture the initial trend leg.
initial_candidates.falsification: Fails if channel breakouts result in immediate mean reversion.
initial_candidates.invalidation: Price fails to sustain the breakout and falls back into the range.
initial_candidates.mechanism: Price breaking a historical channel indicates a new trend formation.
initial_candidates.payer: Counter-trend traders providing liquidity at historical boundaries.
initial_candidates.time_stop_rationale: True breakouts persist; false ones revert quickly.
initial_candidates.turnover_cost_budget: Trend initiation moves are large enough to cover 14bps.
initial_candidates.why_distinct: Replaces MA/MACD crossover logic with pure price-action channel breakouts.
